items.issue: This release run builds and qualifies Windows/WebView2 and Chromium on the named Windows host; clean Linux and macOS package qualification remains an external matching-host task.
items.workaround: Run the documented platform matrix on Linux and macOS before making matching-host installer claims.

items.issue: Exact loop latency is codec, decoder and output-device dependent. PCM has the tightest loop budget; Vorbis/MP3 may contain encoder delay and streaming seeks use the browser media pipeline.
items.workaround: Use PCM for timing-critical short loops, place loop points at zero crossings, and inspect Audio latency/underrun metrics on each target device.

items.issue: Canvas2D fallback cannot execute custom GLSL, GPU timings, normal-map lighting or post-process render targets.
items.workaround: Project Health reports the fallback. Use base materials and supported lighting, or deploy to a WebGL2-capable target.

items.issue: A 24-hour wall-clock visual/audio soak is supplied as a procedure but is not falsely claimed by this local accelerated release run.
items.workaround: Run the stability workflow on named release hardware before claiming 24-hour wall-clock endurance.

items.issue: The Windows bundler reports that its package-type marker is unavailable because the local Tauri CLI 2.9.6 and pinned Rust crate 2.9.5 differ by one patch. Nova_A does not enable the updater plugin; portable, MSI and NSIS launch/install paths are unaffected.
items.workaround: If an updater is added later, align the Tauri CLI/Rust crate patches and requalify updater packages before enabling it.
